name: skies-node-sdk
description: The Skies convention framework for plain TypeScript and Express applications.

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build --workspace @skiesjs/core && npm run build --workspace @skiesjs/openapi && npm run build --workspace @skiesjs/express && npm run build --workspace @skiesjs/auth && npm run build --workspace @skiesjs/auth-express && npm run build --workspace @skiesjs/socketio && npm run build --workspace @skiesjs/identity && npm run build --workspace @skiesjs/mail && npm run build --workspace @skiesjs/sms && npm run build --workspace @skiesjs/storage && npm run build --workspace @skiesjs/storage-express && npm run build --workspace @skiesjs/rate-limit-express && npm run build --workspace @skiesjs/drizzle-postgres && npm run build --workspace @skiesjs/testing && npm run build --workspace @skiesjs/testing-postgres && npm run build --workspace @skiesjs/doctor && npm run build --workspace @skiesjs/foundation && npm run build --workspace @skiesjs/cli && npm run build --workspace @skiesjs/pilot-api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json && tsc --noEmit -p examples/sample-api/tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck --workspace @skiesjs/pilot-api
scripts.doctor: npm run build --workspace @skiesjs/doctor && skies-node-doctor examples/sample-api && skies-node-doctor examples/pilot-api
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:unit
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run doctor && npm run test:unit
